SELECT e.id, e.reservation_id, e.event_type, e.event_at, e.operator_id, e.request_key, e.created_at FROM attendance_event e JOIN reservation r ON r.id = e.reservation_id WHERE e.event_type = 'CHECK_IN' AND e.event_at >= #{from} AND e.event_at < #{to} AND r.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY e.event_at, e.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_event (reservation_id, event_type, event_at, operator_id, request_key, created_at) VALUES (#{reservationId}, #{eventType}, #{eventAt}, #{operatorId}, #{requestKey}, #{createdAt})
